doc.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019

title: Interests: history and baseball
summary: Caine likes history and the St. Louis Cardinals; chat with Rowe about Stan Musial.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Do you have any other interests besides playing the bass?
I like water sports — no I’m just kidding. I mean I like to read history, I like baseball, the Cardinals.
Yeah I was a Cardinals fan. Stan Musial.
Oh yeah, well did you grow up with KMOX radio?
I used to hear them in Rochester, and the Rochester Red Wings used to be the St. Louis Cardinals farm team.
Did you see some guys on the way up?
Yeah, they would come once a year and play and I remember seeing Stan Musial.
He played in four different decades, Stan Musial.
